correctness.rationale: For a k-subset within one part, every minimum Steiner tree has exactly one outside vertex; for a k-subset meeting at least two parts, the induced subgraph is connected and every minimum Steiner tree uses only the terminals. This proves the iff criterion. Exact counting gives the enumerator, extremal size, and maximum-set multiplicity. The bundled verifier checks the definition directly on all complete multipartite graphs through order eight.
